_about: Recorded agent output for fixture mode (phase 03 produces it live with Gemini).

6cf4d2cd04d42a08.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "inventory" and span.name == "SELECT inventory.stock"
| summarize p95 = percentile(duration, 95), by:{$Attribute:backtick}
| sort p95 desc
| limit 20
6cf4d2cd04d42a08.note: The tile groups by a dashboard variable whose values come from a query (fieldsSummary of db.statement). Gemini resolved it to db.statement; the phase-1 parser had missed it and verification caught it on the reverted rule.
